name: Sherri M Wright

summary.text: Sherri Wright is the incumbent State Board of Education member for District 3. She is a retired teacher who has served on local and charter school boards.

experience.text: Colorado State Board of Education, District 3 (incumbent).
Bachelor's degree, Fort Lewis College; master's in secondary education, Adams State University.
Served on the RE-1 school board and taught for 20 years.

education_focus.text: Wright's top priority is third-grade reading proficiency; she says schools should use 'proven, evidence-based instruction, grounded in the science of reading.'
On charter schools, she says declining enrollment alone 'should not prevent a new charter school from opening' because 'families, not enrollment trends, should drive the demand.'
On school accountability, she says she would vote for closure of a persistently low-performing school if prior efforts to improve it had failed.
